147		acceptPrepares := func(_ uint64, message *protos.Message) bool {
148			return message.GetPrepare() != nil

162		acceptCommits := func(sender uint64, message *protos.Message) bool {
163			commit := message.GetCommit()
164			if commit == nil {
165				return false
166			}
167			if commit.Signature == nil {
168				return false
169			}
170			// Sender needs to match the inner signature sender
171			return commit.Signature.Signer == sender
172		}

175			validVote: acceptCommits,
176		}

195	func (v *View) processMsg(sender uint64, m *protos.Message) {
196		if v.Stopped() {
197			return
198		}
199		// Ensure view number is equal to our view
200		msgViewNum := viewNumber(m)
201		msgProposalSeq := proposalSequence(m)
202	
203		if msgViewNum != v.Number {
204			v.Logger.Warnf("%d got message %v from %d of view %d, expected view %d", v.SelfID, m, sender, msgViewNum, v.Number)
205			if sender != v.LeaderID {
206				v.discoverIfSyncNeeded(sender, m)
207				return
208			}
209			v.FailureDetector.Complain(v.Number, false)
210			// Else, we got a message with a wrong view from the leader.
211			if msgViewNum > v.Number {
212				v.Sync.Sync()
213			}
214			v.stop()
215			return
216		}
217	
218		if msgProposalSeq == v.ProposalSequence-1 && v.ProposalSequence > 0 {
219			v.handlePrevSeqMessage(msgProposalSeq, sender, m)
220			return
221		}
222	
223		v.Logger.Debugf("%d got message %s from %d with seq %d", v.SelfID, MsgToString(m), sender, msgProposalSeq)
224		// This message is either for this proposal or the next one (we might be behind the rest)
225		if msgProposalSeq != v.ProposalSequence && msgProposalSeq != v.ProposalSequence+1 {
226			v.Logger.Infof("%d got message from %d with sequence %d but our sequence is %d", v.SelfID, sender, msgProposalSeq, v.ProposalSequence)
227			v.discoverIfSyncNeeded(sender, m)
228			return
229		}
230	
231		msgForNextProposal := msgProposalSeq == v.ProposalSequence+1
232	
233		if pp := m.GetPrePrepare(); pp != nil {
234			v.processPrePrepare(pp, m, msgForNextProposal, sender)
235			return
236		}
237	
238		// Else, it's a prepare or a commit.
239		// Ignore votes from ourselves.
240		if sender == v.SelfID {
241			return
242		}
243	
244		if prp := m.GetPrepare(); prp != nil {
245			if msgForNextProposal {
246				v.nextPrepares.registerVote(sender, m)
247			} else {
248				v.prepares.registerVote(sender, m)
249			}
250			return
251		}
252	
253		if cmt := m.GetCommit(); cmt != nil {
254			if msgForNextProposal {
255				v.nextCommits.registerVote(sender, m)
256			} else {
257				v.commits.registerVote(sender, m)
258			}
259			return
260		}
261	}

291		case COMMITTED:

306		}
307		if sender != v.LeaderID {
308			v.Logger.Warnf("%d got pre-prepare from %d but the leader is %d", v.SelfID, sender, v.LeaderID)
309			return
310		}
311	
312		prePrepareChan := v.prePrepare
313		currentOrNext := "current"
314	
315		if msgForNextProposal {
316			prePrepareChan = v.nextPrePrepare
317			currentOrNext = "next"
318		}
319	
320		select {
321		case prePrepareChan <- m:
322		default:
323			v.Logger.Warnf("Got a pre-prepare for %s sequence without processing previous one, dropping message", currentOrNext)
324		}
325	}

327	func (v *View) prepared() Phase {
328		proposal := v.inFlightProposal
329		signatures, phase := v.processCommits(proposal)
330		if phase == ABORT {
331			return ABORT
332		}
333	
334		seq := v.ProposalSequence
335	
336		v.Logger.Infof("%d processed commits for proposal with seq %d", v.SelfID, seq)
337	
338		v.MetricsView.CountBatchAll.Add(1)
339		v.MetricsView.CountTxsAll.Add(float64(len(v.inFlightRequests)))
340		size := 0
341		size += len(proposal.Metadata) + len(proposal.Header) + len(proposal.Payload)
342		for i := range signatures {
343			size += len(signatures[i].Value) + len(signatures[i].Msg)
344		}
345		v.MetricsView.SizeOfBatch.Add(float64(size))
346		v.MetricsView.LatencyBatchProcessing.Observe(time.Since(v.beginPrePrepare).Seconds())
347	
348		v.decide(proposal, signatures, v.inFlightRequests)
349		return COMMITTED
350	}

352	func (v *View) processProposal() Phase {
353		v.prevPrepareSent = v.currPrepareSent
354		v.prevCommitSent = v.currCommitSent
355		v.currPrepareSent = nil
356		v.currCommitSent = nil
357		v.inFlightProposal = nil
358		v.inFlightRequests = nil
359		v.lastBroadcastSent = nil
360	
361		var proposal types.Proposal
362		var receivedProposal *protos.Message
363		var prevCommits []*protos.Signature
364	
365		var gotPrePrepare bool
366		for !gotPrePrepare {
367			select {
368			case <-v.abortChan:
369				return ABORT
370			case msg := <-v.incMsgs:
371				v.processMsg(msg.sender, msg.Message)
372			case msg := <-v.prePrepare:
373				gotPrePrepare = true
374				receivedProposal = msg
375				prePrepare := msg.GetPrePrepare()
376				prop := prePrepare.Proposal
377				prevCommits = prePrepare.PrevCommitSignatures
378				proposal = types.Proposal{
379					VerificationSequence: int64(prop.VerificationSequence),
380					Metadata:             prop.Metadata,
381					Payload:              prop.Payload,
382					Header:               prop.Header,
383				}
384			}
385		}
386	
387		requests, err := v.verifyProposal(proposal, prevCommits)
388		if err != nil {
389			v.Logger.Warnf("%d received bad proposal from %d: %v", v.SelfID, v.LeaderID, err)
390			v.FailureDetector.Complain(v.Number, false)
391			v.Sync.Sync()
392			v.stop()
393			return ABORT
394		}
395	
396		v.MetricsView.CountTxsInBatch.Set(float64(len(requests)))
397		v.beginPrePrepare = time.Now()
398	
399		seq := v.ProposalSequence
400	
401		prepareMessage := v.createPrepare(seq, proposal)
402	
403		// We are about to send a prepare for a pre-prepare,
404		// so we record the pre-prepare.
405		savedMsg := &protos.SavedMessage{
406			Content: &protos.SavedMessage_ProposedRecord{
407				ProposedRecord: &protos.ProposedRecord{
408					PrePrepare: receivedProposal.GetPrePrepare(),
409					Prepare:    prepareMessage.GetPrepare(),
410				},
411			},
412		}
413		if err = v.State.Save(savedMsg); err != nil {
414			v.Logger.Panicf("Failed to save message to state, error: %v", err)
415		}
416		v.lastBroadcastSent = prepareMessage
417		v.currPrepareSent = proto.Clone(prepareMessage).(*protos.Message)
418		v.currPrepareSent.GetPrepare().Assist = true
419		v.inFlightProposal = &proposal
420		v.inFlightRequests = requests
421	
422		if v.SelfID == v.LeaderID {
423			v.Comm.BroadcastConsensus(receivedProposal)
424		}
425	
426		v.Logger.Infof("Processed proposal with seq %d", seq)
427		return PROPOSED
428	}

434					Seq:    seq,
435					View:   v.Number,
436					Digest: proposal.Digest(),
437				},
438			},

442	func (v *View) processPrepares() Phase {
443		proposal := v.inFlightProposal
444		expectedDigest := proposal.Digest()
445	
446		var voterIDs []uint64
447		for len(voterIDs) < v.Quorum-1 {
448			select {
449			case <-v.abortChan:
450				return ABORT
451			case msg := <-v.incMsgs:
452				v.processMsg(msg.sender, msg.Message)
453			case vote := <-v.prepares.votes:
454				prepare := vote.GetPrepare()
455				if prepare.Digest != expectedDigest {
456					seq := v.ProposalSequence
457					v.Logger.Warnf("Got wrong digest at processPrepares for prepare with seq %d, expecting %v but got %v, we are in seq %d", prepare.Seq, expectedDigest, prepare.Digest, seq)
458					continue
459				}
460				voterIDs = append(voterIDs, vote.sender)
461			}
462		}
463	
464		v.Logger.Infof("%d collected %d prepares from %v", v.SelfID, len(voterIDs), voterIDs)
465	
466		// SignProposal returns a types.Signature with the following 3 fields:
467		// ID: The integer that represents this node.
468		// Value: The signature, encoded according to the specific signature specification.
469		// Msg: A succinct representation of the proposal that binds this proposal unequivocally.
470	
471		// The block proof consists of the aggregation of all these signatures from 2f+1 commits of different nodes.
472	
473		prpFrom := &protos.PreparesFrom{
474			Ids: voterIDs,
475		}
476	
477		prpFromRaw, err := proto.Marshal(prpFrom)
478		if err != nil {
479			v.Logger.Panicf("Failed marshaling prepares from: %v", err)
480		}
481	
482		v.myProposalSig = v.Signer.SignProposal(*proposal, prpFromRaw)
483	
484		seq := v.ProposalSequence
485	
486		commitMsg := &protos.Message{
487			Content: &protos.Message_Commit{
488				Commit: &protos.Commit{
489					View:   v.Number,
490					Digest: expectedDigest,
491					Seq:    seq,
492					Signature: &protos.Signature{
493						Signer: v.myProposalSig.ID,
494						Value:  v.myProposalSig.Value,
495						Msg:    v.myProposalSig.Msg,
496					},
497				},
498			},
499		}
500	
501		preparedProof := &protos.SavedMessage{
502			Content: &protos.SavedMessage_Commit{
503				Commit: commitMsg,
504			},
505		}
506	
507		// We received enough prepares to send a commit.
508		// Save the commit message we are about to send.
509		if err = v.State.Save(preparedProof); err != nil {
510			v.Logger.Panicf("Failed to save message to state, error: %v", err)
511		}
512		v.currCommitSent = proto.Clone(commitMsg).(*protos.Message)
513		v.currCommitSent.GetCommit().Assist = true
514		v.lastBroadcastSent = commitMsg
515	
516		v.Logger.Infof("Processed prepares for proposal with seq %d", seq)
517		return PREPARED
518	}

520	func (v *View) processCommits(proposal *types.Proposal) ([]types.Signature, Phase) {
521		var signatures []types.Signature
522	
523		signatureCollector := &voteVerifier{
524			validVotes:     make(chan types.Signature, cap(v.commits.votes)),
525			expectedDigest: proposal.Digest(),
526			proposal:       proposal,
527			v:              v,
528		}
529	
530		var voterIDs []uint64
531	
532		for len(signatures) < v.Quorum-1 {
533			select {
534			case <-v.abortChan:
535				return nil, ABORT
536			case msg := <-v.incMsgs:
537				v.processMsg(msg.sender, msg.Message)
538			case vote := <-v.commits.votes:
539				// Valid votes end up written into the 'validVotes' channel.
540				go func(vote *protos.Message) {
541					signatureCollector.verifyVote(vote)
542				}(vote.Message)
543			case signature := <-signatureCollector.validVotes:
544				signatures = append(signatures, signature)
545				voterIDs = append(voterIDs, signature.ID)
546			}
547		}
548	
549		v.Logger.Infof("%d collected %d commits from %v", v.SelfID, len(signatures), voterIDs)
550	
551		return signatures, COMMITTED
552	}

554	func (v *View) verifyProposal(proposal types.Proposal, prevCommits []*protos.Signature) ([]types.RequestInfo, error) {
555		// Verify proposal has correct structure and contains authorized requests.
556		requests, err := v.Verifier.VerifyProposal(proposal)
557		if err != nil {
558			v.Logger.Warnf("Received bad proposal: %v", err)
559			return nil, err
560		}
561	
562		// Verify proposal's metadata is valid.
563		md := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
564		if err = proto.Unmarshal(proposal.Metadata, md); err != nil {
565			return nil, err
566		}
567	
568		if md.ViewId != v.Number {
569			v.Logger.Warnf("Expected view number %d but got %d", v.Number, md.ViewId)
570			return nil, errors.New("invalid view number")
571		}
572	
573		if md.LatestSequence != v.ProposalSequence {
574			v.Logger.Warnf("Expected proposal sequence %d but got %d", v.ProposalSequence, md.LatestSequence)
575			return nil, errors.New("invalid proposal sequence")
576		}
577	
578		if md.DecisionsInView != v.DecisionsInView {
579			v.Logger.Warnf("Expected decisions in view %d but got %d", v.DecisionsInView, md.DecisionsInView)
580			return nil, errors.New("invalid decisions in view")
581		}
582	
583		expectedSeq := v.Verifier.VerificationSequence()
584		if uint64(proposal.VerificationSequence) != expectedSeq {
585			v.Logger.Warnf("Expected verification sequence %d but got %d", expectedSeq, proposal.VerificationSequence)
586			return nil, errors.New("verification sequence mismatch")
587		}
588	
589		prepareAcknowledgements, err := v.verifyPrevCommitSignatures(prevCommits, expectedSeq)
590		if err != nil {
591			return nil, err
592		}
593	
594		if err = v.verifyBlacklist(prevCommits, expectedSeq, md.BlackList, prepareAcknowledgements); err != nil {
595			return nil, err
596		}
597	
598		// Check that the metadata contains a digest of the previous commit signatures
599		prevCommitDigest := CommitSignaturesDigest(prevCommits)
600		if !bytes.Equal(prevCommitDigest, md.PrevCommitSignatureDigest) && v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0 {
601			return nil, errors.New("prev commit signatures received from leader mismatches the metadata digest")
602		}
603	
604		return requests, nil
605	}

607	func (v *View) verifyPrevCommitSignatures(prevCommitSignatures []*protos.Signature, currVerificationSeq uint64) (map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom, error) {
608		prevPropRaw, _ := v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
609		prevProposalMetadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
610		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevPropRaw.Metadata, prevProposalMetadata); err != nil {
611			v.Logger.Panicf("Couldn't unmarshal the previous persisted proposal metadata: %v", err)
612		}
613	
614		v.Logger.Debugf("Previous proposal verification sequence: %d, current verification sequence: %d", prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)
615		if prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence != currVerificationSeq {
616			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping verifying prev commit signatures due to verification sequence advancing from %d to %d",
617				prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)
618			return nil, nil
619		}
620	
621		prepareAcknowledgements := make(map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom)
622	
623		prevProp := types.Proposal{
624			VerificationSequence: int64(prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence),
625			Metadata:             prevPropRaw.Metadata,
626			Payload:              prevPropRaw.Payload,
627			Header:               prevPropRaw.Header,
628		}
629	
630		// All previous commit signatures should be verifiable
631		for _, sig := range prevCommitSignatures {
632			aux, err := v.Verifier.VerifyConsenterSig(types.Signature{
633				ID:    sig.Signer,
634				Msg:   sig.Msg,
635				Value: sig.Value,
636			}, prevProp)
637			if err != nil {
638				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed verifying consenter signature of %d: %w", sig.Signer, err)
639			}
640			prpf := &protos.PreparesFrom{}
641			if err = proto.Unmarshal(aux, prpf); err != nil {
642				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed unmarshaling auxiliary input from %d: %w", sig.Signer, err)
643			}
644			prepareAcknowledgements[sig.Signer] = prpf
645		}
646	
647		return prepareAcknowledgements, nil
648	}

650	func (v *View) verifyBlacklist(prevCommitSignatures []*protos.Signature, currVerificationSeq uint64, pendingBlacklist []uint64, prepareAcknowledgements map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom) error {
651		if v.DecisionsPerLeader == 0 {
652			v.Logger.Debugf("DecisionsPerLeader is 0, hence leader rotation is inactive")
653			if len(pendingBlacklist) > 0 {
654				v.Logger.Warnf("Blacklist cannot be non-empty (%v) if rotation is inactive", pendingBlacklist)
655				return fmt.Errorf("rotation is inactive but blacklist is not empty: %v", pendingBlacklist)
656			}
657			return nil
658		}
659	
660		prevPropRaw, myLastCommitSignatures := v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
661		prevProposalMetadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
662		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevPropRaw.Metadata, prevProposalMetadata); err != nil {
663			v.Logger.Panicf("Couldn't unmarshal the previous persisted proposal metadata: %v", err)
664		}
665	
666		v.Logger.Debugf("Previous proposal verification sequence: %d, current verification sequence: %d", prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)
667		if prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence != currVerificationSeq {
668			// If there has been a reconfiguration, black list should remain the same
669			if !slices.Equal(prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist) {
670				return fmt.Errorf("blacklist changed (%v --> %v) during reconfiguration", prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist)
671			}
672			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping verifying prev commits due to verification sequence advancing from %d to %d",
673				prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)
674			return nil
675		}
676	
677		if v.MembershipNotifier != nil && v.MembershipNotifier.MembershipChange() {
678			// If there has been a membership change, black list should remain the same
679			if !slices.Equal(prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist) {
680				return fmt.Errorf("blacklist changed (%v --> %v) during membership change", prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist)
681			}
682			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping verifying prev commits due to membership change")
683			return nil
684		}
685	
686		_, f := computeQuorum(v.N)
687	
688		if v.blacklistingSupported(f, myLastCommitSignatures) && len(prevCommitSignatures) < len(myLastCommitSignatures) {
689			return fmt.Errorf("only %d out of %d required previous commits is included in pre-prepare",
690				len(prevCommitSignatures), len(myLastCommitSignatures))
691		}
692	
693		// We previously verified the previous commit signatures, now we need to ensure that the blacklist
694		// of this proposal is obtained by applying the deterministic blacklist maintenance algorithm
695		// on the blacklist of the previous proposal which has been committed.
696	
697		blacklist := &blacklist{
698			currentLeader:      v.LeaderID,
699			leaderRotation:     v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0,
700			n:                  v.N,
701			prevMD:             prevProposalMetadata,
702			decisionsPerLeader: v.DecisionsPerLeader,
703			preparesFrom:       prepareAcknowledgements,
704			f:                  f,
705			logger:             v.Logger,
706			metricsBlacklist:   v.MetricsBlacklist,
707			nodes:              v.NodesList,
708			currView:           v.Number,
709		}
710	
711		expectedBlacklist := blacklist.computeUpdate()
712		if !slices.Equal(pendingBlacklist, expectedBlacklist) {
713			return fmt.Errorf("proposed blacklist %v differs from expected %v blacklist", pendingBlacklist, expectedBlacklist)
714		}
715	
716		return nil
717	}

719	func (v *View) handlePrevSeqMessage(msgProposalSeq, sender uint64, m *protos.Message) {
720		if m.GetPrePrepare() != nil {
721			v.Logger.Warnf("Got pre-prepare for sequence %d but we're in sequence %d", msgProposalSeq, v.ProposalSequence)
722			return
723		}
724		msgType := "prepare"
725		if m.GetCommit() != nil {
726			msgType = "commit"
727		}
728	
729		var found bool
730	
731		switch msgType {
732		case "prepare":
733			// This is an assist message, we don't need to reply to it.
734			if m.GetPrepare().Assist {
735				return
736			}
737			if v.prevPrepareSent != nil {
738				v.Comm.SendConsensus(sender, v.prevPrepareSent)
739				found = true
740			}
741		case "commit":
742			// This is an assist message, we don't need to reply to it.
743			if m.GetCommit().Assist {
744				return
745			}
746			if v.prevCommitSent != nil {
747				v.Comm.SendConsensus(sender, v.prevCommitSent)
748				found = true
749			}
750		}
751	
752		prevMsgFound := fmt.Sprintf("but didn't have a previous %s to send back.", msgType)
753		if found {
754			prevMsgFound = fmt.Sprintf("sent back previous %s.", msgType)
755		}
756		v.Logger.Debugf("Got %s for previous sequence (%d) from %d, %s", msgType, msgProposalSeq, sender, prevMsgFound)
757	}

759	func (v *View) discoverIfSyncNeeded(sender uint64, m *protos.Message) {
760		// We're only interested in commit messages.
761		commit := m.GetCommit()
762		if commit == nil {
763			return
764		}
765	
766		// To commit a block we need 2f + 1 votes.
767		// at least f+1 of them are honest and will broadcast
768		// their commits to votes to everyone including us.
769		// In each such a threshold of f+1 votes there is at least
770		// a single honest node that prepared for a proposal
771		// which we apparently missed.
772		_, f := computeQuorum(v.N)
773		threshold := f + 1
774	
775		v.lastVotedProposalByID[sender] = commit
776	
777		v.Logger.Debugf("Got commit of seq %d in view %d from %d while being in seq %d in view %d",
778			commit.Seq, commit.View, sender, v.ProposalSequence, v.Number)
779	
780		// If we haven't reached a threshold of proposals yet, abort.
781		if len(v.lastVotedProposalByID) < threshold {
782			return
783		}
784	
785		// Make a histogram out of all current seen votes.
786		countsByVotes := make(map[proposalInfo]int)
787		for _, vote := range v.lastVotedProposalByID {
788			info := proposalInfo{
789				digest: vote.Digest,
790				view:   vote.View,
791				seq:    vote.Seq,
792			}
793			countsByVotes[info]++
794		}
795	
796		// Check if there is a <digest, view, seq> that collected a threshold of votes,
797		// and that sequence is higher than our current sequence, or our view is different.
798		for vote, count := range countsByVotes {
799			if count < threshold {
800				continue
801			}
802	
803			// Disregard votes for past views.
804			if vote.view < v.Number {
805				continue
806			}
807	
808			// Disregard votes for past sequences for this view.
809			if vote.seq <= v.ProposalSequence && vote.view == v.Number {
810				continue
811			}
812	
813			v.Logger.Warnf("Seen %d votes for digest %s in view %d, sequence %d but I am in view %d and seq %d",
814				count, vote.digest, vote.view, vote.seq, v.Number, v.ProposalSequence)
815			v.stop()
816			v.Sync.Sync()
817			return
818		}
819	}

821	type voteVerifier struct {
822		v              *View
823		proposal       *types.Proposal
824		expectedDigest string
825		validVotes     chan types.Signature

828	func (vv *voteVerifier) verifyVote(vote *protos.Message) {
829		commit := vote.GetCommit()
830		if commit.Digest != vv.expectedDigest {
831			vv.v.Logger.Warnf("Got wrong digest at processCommits for seq %d", commit.Seq)
832			return
833		}
834	
835		_, err := vv.v.Verifier.VerifyConsenterSig(types.Signature{
836			ID:    commit.Signature.Signer,
837			Value: commit.Signature.Value,
838			Msg:   commit.Signature.Msg,
839		}, *vv.proposal)
840		if err != nil {
841			vv.v.Logger.Warnf("Couldn't verify %d's signature: %v", commit.Signature.Signer, err)
842			return
843		}
844	
845		vv.validVotes <- types.Signature{
846			ID:    commit.Signature.Signer,
847			Value: commit.Signature.Value,
848			Msg:   commit.Signature.Msg,
849		}
850	}

852	func (v *View) decide(proposal *types.Proposal, signatures []types.Signature, requests []types.RequestInfo) {
853		v.Logger.Infof("Deciding on seq %d", v.ProposalSequence)
854		v.ViewSequences.Store(ViewSequence{ProposalSeq: v.ProposalSequence, ViewActive: true})
855		// first make preparations for the next sequence so that the view will be ready to continue right after delivery
856		v.startNextSeq()
857		signatures = append(signatures, *v.myProposalSig)
858		v.Decider.Decide(*proposal, signatures, requests)
859	}

861	func (v *View) startNextSeq() {
862		prevSeq := v.ProposalSequence
863	
864		v.ProposalSequence++
865		v.DecisionsInView++
866	
867		nextSeq := v.ProposalSequence
868	
869		v.MetricsView.ProposalSequence.Set(float64(v.ProposalSequence))
870		v.MetricsView.DecisionsInView.Set(float64(v.DecisionsInView))
871	
872		v.Logger.Infof("Sequence: %d-->%d", prevSeq, nextSeq)
873	
874		// swap next prePrepare
875		tmp := v.prePrepare
876		v.prePrepare = v.nextPrePrepare
877		// clear tmp
878		for len(tmp) > 0 {
879			<-tmp
880		}
881		tmp = make(chan *protos.Message, 1)
882		v.nextPrePrepare = tmp
883	
884		// swap next prepares
885		tmpVotes := v.prepares
886		v.prepares = v.nextPrepares
887		tmpVotes.clear(v.N)
888		v.nextPrepares = tmpVotes
889	
890		// swap next commits
891		tmpVotes = v.commits
892		v.commits = v.nextCommits
893		tmpVotes.clear(v.N)
894		v.nextCommits = tmpVotes
895	}

897	// GetMetadata returns the current sequence and view number (in a marshaled ViewMetadata protobuf message)
898	func (v *View) GetMetadata() []byte {
899		metadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{
900			ViewId:          v.Number,
901			LatestSequence:  v.ProposalSequence,
902			DecisionsInView: v.DecisionsInView,
903		}
904	
905		v.Logger.Debugf("GetMetadata with view %d, seq %d, dec %d", metadata.ViewId, metadata.LatestSequence, metadata.DecisionsInView)
906	
907		var (
908			prevSigs []*protos.Signature
909			prevProp *protos.Proposal
910		)
911		verificationSeq := v.Verifier.VerificationSequence()
912	
913		prevProp, prevSigs = v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
914	
915		prevMD := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
916		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevProp.Metadata, prevMD); err != nil {
917			v.Logger.Panicf("Attempted to propose a proposal with invalid unchanged previous proposal view metadata: %v", err)
918		}
919	
920		metadata.BlackList = prevMD.BlackList
921	
922		metadata = v.metadataWithUpdatedBlacklist(metadata, verificationSeq, prevProp, prevSigs)
923		metadata = v.bindCommitSignaturesToProposalMetadata(metadata, prevSigs)
924	
925		return MarshalOrPanic(metadata)
926	}
927	
928	func (v *View) metadataWithUpdatedBlacklist(metadata *protos.ViewMetadata, verificationSeq uint64, prevProp *protos.Proposal, prevSigs []*protos.Signature) *protos.ViewMetadata {
929		var membershipChange bool
930		if v.MembershipNotifier != nil {
931			membershipChange = v.MembershipNotifier.MembershipChange()
932		}
933	
934		if verificationSeq == prevProp.VerificationSequence && !membershipChange {
935			v.Logger.Debugf("Proposing proposal %d with verification sequence of %d and %d commit signatures",
936				v.ProposalSequence, verificationSeq, len(prevSigs))
937			return v.updateBlacklistMetadata(metadata, prevSigs, prevProp.Metadata)
938		}
939	
940		if verificationSeq != prevProp.VerificationSequence {
941			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping updating blacklist due to verification sequence changing from %d to %d",
942				prevProp.VerificationSequence, verificationSeq)
943		}
944		if membershipChange {
945			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping updating blacklist due to membership change")
946		}
947	
948		return metadata
949	}
950	
951	// Propose broadcasts a prePrepare message with the given proposal
952	func (v *View) Propose(proposal types.Proposal) {
953		var prevSigs []*protos.Signature
954		if v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0 {
955			_, prevSigs = v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
956		}
957	
958		seq := v.ProposalSequence
959		msg := &protos.Message{
960			Content: &protos.Message_PrePrepare{
961				PrePrepare: &protos.PrePrepare{
962					View: v.Number,
963					Seq:  seq,
964					Proposal: &protos.Proposal{
965						Header:               proposal.Header,
966						Payload:              proposal.Payload,
967						Metadata:             proposal.Metadata,
968						VerificationSequence: uint64(proposal.VerificationSequence),
969					},
970					PrevCommitSignatures: prevSigs,
971				},
972			},
973		}
974		// Send the proposal to yourself in order to pre-prepare yourself and record
975		// it in the WAL before sending it to other nodes.
976		v.HandleMessage(v.LeaderID, msg)
977		v.Logger.Debugf("Proposing proposal sequence %d in view %d", seq, v.Number)
978	}
979	
980	func (v *View) bindCommitSignaturesToProposalMetadata(metadata *protos.ViewMetadata, prevSigs []*protos.Signature) *protos.ViewMetadata {
981		if v.DecisionsPerLeader == 0 {
982			v.Logger.Debugf("Leader rotation is disabled, will not bind signatures to proposals")
983			return metadata
984		}
985		metadata.PrevCommitSignatureDigest = CommitSignaturesDigest(prevSigs)
986	
987		if len(metadata.PrevCommitSignatureDigest) == 0 {
988			v.Logger.Debugf("No previous commit signatures detected")
989		} else {
990			v.Logger.Debugf("Bound %d commit signatures to proposal", len(prevSigs))
991		}
992		return metadata
993	}
994	
995	func (v *View) stop() {
996		v.stopOnce.Do(func() {
997			if v.abortChan == nil {
998				return
999			}
1000			close(v.abortChan)
1001		})
1002	}
1003	
1004	// Abort forces the view to end
1005	func (v *View) Abort() {
1006		v.stop()
1007		v.viewEnded.Wait()
1008	}
1009	
1010	func (v *View) Stopped() bool {
1011		select {
1012		case <-v.abortChan:
1013			return true
1014		default:
1015			return false
1016		}
1017	}
1018	
1019	func (v *View) AbortChan() <-chan struct{} {
1020		return v.abortChan
1021	}
1022	
1023	func (v *View) GetLeaderID() uint64 {
1024		return v.LeaderID
1025	}
1026	
1027	func (v *View) updateBlacklistMetadata(metadata *protos.ViewMetadata, prevSigs []*protos.Signature, prevMetadata []byte) *protos.ViewMetadata {
1028		if v.DecisionsPerLeader == 0 {
1029			v.Logger.Debugf("Rotation is disabled, setting blacklist to be empty")
1030			metadata.BlackList = nil
1031			return metadata
1032		}
1033	
1034		preparesFrom := make(map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom)
1035	
1036		for _, sig := range prevSigs {
1037			aux := v.Verifier.AuxiliaryData(sig.Msg)
1038			prpf := &protos.PreparesFrom{}
1039			if err := proto.Unmarshal(aux, prpf); err != nil {
1040				v.Logger.Panicf("Failed unmarshalling auxiliary data from previously persisted signatures: %v", err)
1041			}
1042			preparesFrom[sig.Signer] = prpf
1043		}
1044	
1045		prevMD := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
1046		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevMetadata, prevMD); err != nil {
1047			v.Logger.Panicf("Attempted to propose a proposal with invalid previous proposal view metadata: %v", err)
1048		}
1049	
1050		_, f := computeQuorum(v.N)
1051	
1052		blacklist := &blacklist{
1053			currentLeader:      v.LeaderID,
1054			leaderRotation:     v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0,
1055			currView:           metadata.ViewId,
1056			prevMD:             prevMD,
1057			nodes:              v.NodesList,
1058			f:                  f,
1059			n:                  v.N,
1060			logger:             v.Logger,
1061			metricsBlacklist:   v.MetricsBlacklist,
1062			preparesFrom:       preparesFrom,
1063			decisionsPerLeader: v.DecisionsPerLeader,
1064		}
1065		metadata.BlackList = blacklist.computeUpdate()
1066		return metadata
1067	}
1068	
1069	func (v *View) blacklistingSupported(f int, myLastCommitSignatures []*protos.Signature) bool {
1070		// Once we blacklist, there is no way back. This is a one way trip, unless we downgrade the version
1071		// in all nodes and view change.
1072		if v.blacklistSupported {
1073			return true
1074		}
1075		// We wish to find whether there are f+1 witnesses for blacklisting being
1076		// activated among the signed commits of the previous proposal.
1077		var count int
1078		for _, commitSig := range myLastCommitSignatures {
1079			aux := v.Verifier.AuxiliaryData(commitSig.Msg)
1080			if len(aux) > 0 {
1081				count++
1082			}
1083		}
1084	
1085		v.Logger.Debugf("Found %d out of %d required witnesses for auxiliary data", count, f+1)
1086	
1087		blacklistSupported := count > f
1088	
1089		// We cache the result in case it is 'true'.
1090		// Subsequent invocations will skip the parsing.
1091		v.blacklistSupported = v.blacklistSupported || blacklistSupported
1092		return blacklistSupported
1093	}

311		c.Logger.Debugf("Heartbeat timeout expired, reported-view: %d, reported-leader: %d", view, leaderID)
312	
313		iAm, currentLeaderID := c.iAmTheLeader()
314		if iAm {
315			c.Logger.Debugf("Heartbeat timeout expired, this node is the leader, nothing to do; current-view: %d, current-leader: %d",
316				c.getCurrentViewNumber(), currentLeaderID)
317			return
318		}
319	
320		if leaderID != currentLeaderID {
321			c.Logger.Warnf("Heartbeat timeout expired, but current leader: %d, differs from reported leader: %d; ignoring", currentLeaderID, leaderID)
322			return
323		}

329	// ProcessMessages dispatches the incoming message to the required component
330	func (c *Controller) ProcessMessages(sender uint64, m *protos.Message) {
331		c.Logger.Debugf("%d got message from %d: %s", c.ID, sender, MsgToString(m))
332		switch m.GetContent().(type) {
333		case *protos.Message_PrePrepare, *protos.Message_Prepare, *protos.Message_Commit:
334			c.currViewLock.RLock()
335			view := c.currView
336			c.currViewLock.RUnlock()
337			view.HandleMessage(sender, m)
338			c.ViewChanger.HandleViewMessage(sender, m)
339			if sender == c.leaderID() {
340				c.LeaderMonitor.InjectArtificialHeartbeat(sender, c.convertViewMessageToHeartbeat(m))
341			}
342		case *protos.Message_ViewChange, *protos.Message_ViewData, *protos.Message_NewView:
343			c.ViewChanger.HandleMessage(sender, m)
344		case *protos.Message_HeartBeat, *protos.Message_HeartBeatResponse:
345			c.LeaderMonitor.ProcessMsg(sender, m)
346		case *protos.Message_StateTransferRequest:
347			c.respondToStateTransferRequest(sender)
348		case *protos.Message_StateTransferResponse:
349			c.Collector.HandleMessage(sender, m)
350		default:
351			c.Logger.Warnf("Unexpected message type, ignoring")
352		}
353	}

355	func (c *Controller) respondToStateTransferRequest(sender uint64) {
356		vs := c.ViewSequences.Load()
357		if vs == nil {

359		}
360		msg := &protos.Message{
361			Content: &protos.Message_StateTransferResponse{
362				StateTransferResponse: &protos.StateTransferResponse{
363					ViewNum:  c.getCurrentViewNumber(),
364					Sequence: vs.(ViewSequence).ProposalSeq,
365				},
366			},
367		}

372		view := viewNumber(m)
373		seq := proposalSequence(m)
374		return &protos.Message{
375			Content: &protos.Message_HeartBeat{
376				HeartBeat: &protos.HeartBeat{
377					View: view,
378					Seq:  seq,
379				},
380			},

384	func (c *Controller) startView(proposalSequence uint64) {
385		view, initPhase := c.ProposerBuilder.NewProposer(c.leaderID(), proposalSequence, c.currViewNumber, c.currDecisionsInView, c.quorum)
386	
387		c.currViewLock.Lock()
388		c.currView = view
389		c.currView.Start()
390		c.currViewLock.Unlock()
391	
392		role := Follower
393		leader, _ := c.iAmTheLeader()
394		if leader {
395			if initPhase == COMMITTED || initPhase == ABORT {
396				c.Logger.Debugf("Acquiring leader token when starting view with phase %s", initPhase.String())
397				c.acquireLeaderToken()
398			} else {
399				c.Logger.Debugf("Not acquiring leader token when starting view with phase %s", initPhase.String())
400			}
401			role = Leader
402		}
403		c.LeaderMonitor.ChangeRole(role, c.currViewNumber, c.leaderID())
404		c.Logger.Infof("Starting view with number %d, sequence %d, and decisions %d", c.currViewNumber, proposalSequence, c.currDecisionsInView)
405	}
406	
407	func (c *Controller) changeView(newViewNumber uint64, newProposalSequence uint64, newDecisionsInView uint64) {
408		latestView := c.getCurrentViewNumber()
409		if latestView > newViewNumber {
410			c.Logger.Debugf("Got view change to %d but already at %d", newViewNumber, latestView)
411			return
412		}
413	
414		leader := c.currentViewLeader()
415		stopped := c.currentViewStopped()
416	
417		if !stopped && latestView == newViewNumber && c.leaderID() == leader &&
418			c.getCurrentDecisionsInView() == newDecisionsInView {
419			c.Logger.Debugf("Got view change to %d but view is already running", newViewNumber)
420			return
421		}
422	
423		if !c.abortView(latestView) {
424			return
425		}
426	
427		c.setCurrentViewNumber(newViewNumber)
428		c.setCurrentDecisionsInView(newDecisionsInView)
429		c.Logger.Debugf("Starting view after setting decisions in view to %d", newDecisionsInView)
430		c.startView(newProposalSequence)
431	
432		if iAm, _ := c.iAmTheLeader(); iAm {
433			c.Batcher.Reset()

503			c.currView.Abort()
504		}()

506		for {
507			select {
508			case d := <-c.decisionChan:
509				c.decide(d)
510			case newView := <-c.viewChange:
511				c.Logger.Debugf("get newView from viewChange")
512				c.changeView(newView.viewNumber, newView.proposalSeq, 0)
513			case view := <-c.abortViewChan:
514				c.abortView(view)
515			case <-c.stopChan:
516				return
517			case <-c.leaderToken:
518				c.propose()
519			case <-c.syncChan:
520				c.Logger.Debugf("get msg from syncChan")
521				view, seq, dec := c.sync()
522				c.MaybePruneRevokedRequests()
523				if view > 0 || seq > 0 {
524					c.changeView(view, seq, dec)
525				} else {
526					c.Logger.Debugf("view and seq is zero")
527					vs := c.ViewSequences.Load()
528					if vs == nil {

544		c.removeDeliveredFromPool(d)
545		select {
546		case c.deliverChan <- struct{}{}:

572		c.Logger.Debugf("view(%d) + (decisionsInView(%d) / decisionsPerLeader(%d)), N(%d), blacklist(%v)",
573			view, decisionsInView, c.DecisionsPerLeader, c.N, blacklist)
574		// called after increment
575		currLeader := getLeaderID(view, c.N, c.NodesList, c.LeaderRotation, decisionsInView-1, c.DecisionsPerLeader, blacklist)
576		nextLeader := getLeaderID(view, c.N, c.NodesList, c.LeaderRotation, decisionsInView, c.DecisionsPerLeader, blacklist)
577		shouldWeRotate := currLeader != nextLeader
578		if shouldWeRotate {

585	func (c *Controller) sync() (viewNum uint64, seq uint64, decisions uint64) {
586		// Block any concurrent sync attempt.
587		c.grabSyncToken()
588		// At exit, enable sync once more, but ignore
589		// all synchronization attempts done while
590		// we were syncing.
591		defer c.relinquishSyncToken()
592	
593		c.syncLock.Lock()
594		defer c.syncLock.Unlock()
595	
596		syncResponse := c.Synchronizer.Sync()
597		if syncResponse.Reconfig.InReplicatedDecisions {
598			c.close()
599			c.ViewChanger.close()
600		}
601	
602		// The synchronizer returns a response which includes the latest decision with its proposal metadata.
603		// This proposal may be empty (its metadata is empty), meaning the synchronizer is not aware of any decisions made.
604		// Otherwise, the latest proposal sequence returned may be higher than our latest sequence, meaning we should
605		// update the checkpoint.
606		// In other cases we should not update the checkpoint.
607		// However, we always must fetch the latest state from other nodes,
608		// since the view may have advanced without this node and with no decisions.
609	
610		var newViewNum, newProposalSequence, newDecisionsInView uint64
611	
612		latestDecision := syncResponse.Latest
613		var latestDecisionSeq, latestDecisionViewNum, latestDecisionDecisions uint64
614		var latestDecisionMetadata *protos.ViewMetadata
615		if len(latestDecision.Proposal.Metadata) == 0 {
616			c.Logger.Infof("Synchronizer returned with an empty proposal metadata")
617			latestDecisionMetadata = nil
618		} else {
619			md := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
620			if err := proto.Unmarshal(latestDecision.Proposal.Metadata, md); err != nil {
621				c.Logger.Panicf("Controller was unable to unmarshal the proposal metadata returned by the Synchronizer")
622			}
623			latestDecisionSeq = md.LatestSequence
624			latestDecisionViewNum = md.ViewId
625			latestDecisionDecisions = md.DecisionsInView
626			latestDecisionMetadata = md
627		}
628	
629		controllerSequence := c.latestSeq()
630		newProposalSequence = controllerSequence + 1
631	
632		controllerViewNum := c.currViewNumber
633		newViewNum = controllerViewNum
634	
635		newDecisionsInView = c.getCurrentDecisionsInView()
636	
637		if latestDecisionSeq > controllerSequence {
638			c.Logger.Infof("Synchronizer returned with sequence %d while the controller is at sequence %d", latestDecisionSeq, controllerSequence)
639			c.Logger.Debugf("Node %d is setting the checkpoint after sync returned with view %d and seq %d", c.ID, latestDecisionViewNum, latestDecisionSeq)
640			c.Checkpoint.Set(latestDecision.Proposal, latestDecision.Signatures)
641			c.verificationSequence.Store(uint64(latestDecision.Proposal.VerificationSequence))
642			newProposalSequence = latestDecisionSeq + 1
643			newDecisionsInView = latestDecisionDecisions + 1
644		}
645	
646		if latestDecisionViewNum > controllerViewNum {
647			c.Logger.Infof("Synchronizer returned with view number %d while the controller is at view number %d", latestDecisionViewNum, controllerViewNum)
648			newViewNum = latestDecisionViewNum
649		}
650	
651		response := c.fetchState()
652		if response == nil {
653			c.Logger.Infof("Fetching state failed")
654			if latestDecisionMetadata == nil || latestDecisionViewNum < controllerViewNum {
655				// And the synchronizer did not return a new view
656				return 0, 0, 0
657			}
658		} else {
659			if response.View <= controllerViewNum && latestDecisionViewNum < controllerViewNum {
660				return 0, 0, 0 // no new view to report
661			}
662			if response.View > newViewNum && response.Seq == latestDecisionSeq+1 {
663				c.Logger.Infof("Node %d collected state with view %d and sequence %d", c.ID, response.View, response.Seq)
664				newViewToSave := &protos.SavedMessage{
665					Content: &protos.SavedMessage_NewView{
666						NewView: &protos.ViewMetadata{
667							ViewId:          response.View,
668							LatestSequence:  latestDecisionSeq,
669							DecisionsInView: 0,
670						},
671					},
672				}
673				if err := c.State.Save(newViewToSave); err != nil {
674					c.Logger.Panicf("Failed to save message to state, error: %v", err)
675				}
676				newViewNum = response.View
677				newDecisionsInView = 0
678			}
679		}
680	
681		if latestDecisionMetadata != nil {
682			c.maybePruneInFlight(latestDecisionMetadata)
683		}
684	
685		if newViewNum > controllerViewNum {
686			c.Logger.Debugf("Node %d is informing the view changer of view %d after sync of view %d and seq %d", c.ID, newViewNum, latestDecisionViewNum, latestDecisionSeq)
687			c.ViewChanger.InformNewView(newViewNum)
688		}
689	
690		return newViewNum, newProposalSequence, newDecisionsInView
691	}

693	func (c *Controller) maybePruneInFlight(syncResultViewMD *protos.ViewMetadata) {
694		inFlight := c.InFlight.InFlightProposal()
695		if inFlight == nil {
696			c.Logger.Debugf("No in-flight proposal to prune")
697			return
698		}
699		inFlightMD := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
700		if err := proto.Unmarshal(inFlight.Metadata, inFlightMD); err != nil {
701			c.Logger.Panicf("In-flight proposal was malformed: %v", err)
702		}
703		c.Logger.Debugf("In-flight proposal: view: %d, seq: %d", inFlightMD.ViewId, inFlightMD.LatestSequence)
704		c.Logger.Debugf("Sync result: view: %d, seq: %d", syncResultViewMD.ViewId, syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence)
705	
706		// If in-flight sequence is higher than latest committed sequence then in-flight might still be relevant
707		if syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence < inFlightMD.LatestSequence {
708			c.Logger.Infof("In-flight sequence is %d but latest committed sequence is %d, will not delete in-flight", inFlightMD.LatestSequence, syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence)
709			return
710		}
711		// Else we have replicated the in-flight proposal from another node or have committed it in the past,
712		// so we whenever we participate in a view change there will be no need to present this in-flight
713		// as we have corresponding signatures on the proposal.
714		c.Logger.Infof("Synced to sequence %d, deleting in-flight as it is stale", syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence)
715		c.InFlight.clear()
716	}

944	func (med *MutuallyExclusiveDeliver) Deliver(proposal types.Proposal, signature []types.Signature) types.Reconfig {
945		pendingProposalMetadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
946		if err := proto.Unmarshal(proposal.Metadata, pendingProposalMetadata); err != nil {
947			med.C.Logger.Panicf("Failed unmarshalling metadata of pending proposal: %v", err)
948		}
949		med.C.syncLock.Lock()
950		defer med.C.syncLock.Unlock()
951	
952		// Fetch latest sequence from the latest checkpoint and compare it to the proposal that is about to be committed (pending).
953		// If the pending proposal's sequence has already been committed in the past,
954		// do not proceed to commit the proposal, but instead invoke a sync and update the checkpoint once more
955		// to match the sync result.
956		latest := med.C.latestSeq()
957		if latest != 0 && latest >= pendingProposalMetadata.LatestSequence {
958			med.C.Logger.Infof("Attempted to deliver block %d via view change but meanwhile view change already synced to seq %d, "+
959				"returning result from sync", pendingProposalMetadata.LatestSequence, latest)
960			syncResult := med.C.Synchronizer.Sync()
961			med.C.Checkpoint.Set(syncResult.Latest.Proposal, syncResult.Latest.Signatures)
962			return types.Reconfig{
963				CurrentNodes:     syncResult.Reconfig.CurrentNodes,
964				InLatestDecision: syncResult.Reconfig.InReplicatedDecisions,
965				CurrentConfig:    syncResult.Reconfig.CurrentConfig,
966			}
967		}
968	
969		begin := time.Now()
970		result := med.C.Application.Deliver(proposal, signature)
971		med.C.MetricsView.LatencyBatchSave.Observe(time.Since(begin).Seconds())
972	
973		// Only set the proposal in case it is later than the already known checkpoint.
974		med.C.Checkpoint.Set(proposal, signature)
975	
976		return result
977	}

**FINDING ST-4: storeProposal and storePrepared in Save() update InFlightData in memory without atomicity with WAL append**

File: `state.go:38-58`

```go
func (ps *PersistedState) Save(msgToSave *protos.SavedMessage) error {
    if proposed := msgToSave.GetProposedRecord(); proposed != nil {
        ps.storeProposal(proposed)      // updates in-memory InFlightData
    }
    if prepared := msgToSave.GetCommit(); prepared != nil {
        ps.storePrepared(prepared)      // updates in-memory InFlightData
    }
    ...
    return ps.WAL.Append(b, newProposal)   // persists to disk
}
```

`storeProposal` and `storePrepared` update the in-memory `InFlightData` *before* `WAL.Append` returns. If `WAL.Append` fails (returns an error), the code does `v.Logger.Panicf` (in the callers), so the node crashes. But: if the OS call completes the WAL write but then `WAL.Append` returns an error for some other reason (e.g., an error in flushing/syncing), the in-memory state has been updated but the view code panics. On restart, `InFlightData` is freshly initialized (zero) but the WAL has the record — a discrepancy between what `Restore` re-populates and what the fresh `InFlightData` has seen. This is not catastrophic because `Restore` re-calls `storeProposal`/`storePrepared` from WAL, but it means the in-flight state during the panic window is inconsistent with what actually got persisted.

**FINDING ST-5: Restore sets v.Phase = COMMITTED initially, then may return without updating it**

File: `state.go:115-152`

```go

    v.Phase = COMMITTED
    ...
    if newViewMsg := lastPersistedMessage.GetNewView(); newViewMsg != nil {
        return nil   // Phase stays COMMITTED, View.Number not set from WAL

    if viewChangeMsg := lastPersistedMessage.GetViewChange(); viewChangeMsg != nil {

    }
```

When the last WAL entry is a NewView or ViewChange record, `Restore` returns successfully with `v.Phase = COMMITTED` and `v.Number` unset (zero). However, `v.Phase` remains `COMMITTED` even if the node was in the middle of a view-change when it crashed, which means on restart the controller starts in COMMITTED phase (normal case), broadcasts nothing, and waits for a new pre-prepare. This effectively makes the node send ViewData to the new leader as soon as it restarts after a view-change crash, which is the intended behavior — but it means `processViewChangeMsg(restore=true)` skips all validation of the f+1 threshold and proceeds unconditionally.

**FINDING SC-1: collectedEnoughEqualVotes uses f+1 threshold (count > f), not quorum — inconsistency with consensus quorum**

File: `statecollector.go:103-128`

```go
func (s *StateCollector) collectedEnoughEqualVotes() *types.ViewAndSeq {
    if len(s.responses.voted) <= s.f {
        return nil
    }
    ...
    for viewAndSeq, count := range votesMap {
        if count > uint64(s.f) {    // f+1 threshold
            return &viewAndSeq
        }
    }
```

The early exit guard (`<= s.f`, i.e., requires at least `f+1` total responses) and the count threshold (`> s.f`, i.e., `f+1` matching responses) means only `f+1` equal responses are needed to determine the view and sequence to sync to. With `f` Byzantine nodes, `f+1` responses guarantees at least 1 honest responder. However, `f+1` honest responses could report different view/sequence values if they are at different states. The function accepts the *first* `(view, seq)` pair that has `f+1` matching votes — but with `f` Byzantine nodes all reporting the same fake `(view, seq)`, a single honest node agreeing with them would trigger a sync to a wrong state. The correct threshold for a result that `f` Byzantines cannot forge alone should be `quorum` (= `ceil((N+f+1)/2)`), not `f+1`. Using `f+1` makes state synchronization susceptible to Byzantine manipulation: `f` adversarial nodes can collude with 1 legitimate slow node to convince a syncing node to go to an incorrect or stale view number. The `quorum` field is computed at `Start()` but never used in `collectedEnoughEqualVotes`.

**FINDING SC-2: ClearCollected drains incMsgs by polling len() — TOCTOU race**

File: `statecollector.go:69-73`

```go
func (s *StateCollector) ClearCollected() {
    for len(s.incMsgs) > 0 {
        <-s.incMsgs
    }
}
```

`len(s.incMsgs)` and the subsequent receive are not atomic. If new messages arrive between `len()` and `<-`, those messages will be received in the drain loop (which is fine). But if messages arrive *after* the loop exits but before `CollectStateResponses` calls `s.responses.clear(s.N)`, they sit in `incMsgs` and will be counted in the *new* collection round. Because `ClearCollected` is called from `Controller.fetchState()` (controller.go:724) before broadcasting the state-transfer request, and responses are expected to arrive *after* the broadcast, any stale response that arrives after `ClearCollected` exits but before or during the broadcast will be counted as a fresh response. This is a TOCTOU race on the channel state: `ClearCollected` does not guarantee the channel is empty *at the start of* `CollectStateResponses`.

**FINDING SC-3: HandleMessage drops messages silently when incMsgs is full**

case s.incMsgs <- msg:

**FINDING X-1: View-change to next-view is always +1 — no skip-view support, stale lagging-node help logic can loop**

File: `viewchanger.go:278-299`

```go
if vc.NextView == v.currView+1 {   // only accept immediate next view
    v.viewChangeMsgs.registerVote(sender, m)
    v.processViewChangeMsg(false)
    return
}
if v.nextView == v.currView+1 &&
   vc.NextView > v.realView &&
   vc.NextView < v.currView+1 &&   // impossible: NextView < currView+1 but > realView
   v.nvs.sendRecv(vc.NextView, sender) {
    // broadcast the old view-change message back
```

The condition `vc.NextView < v.currView+1` means `vc.NextView <= v.currView`. Combined with `vc.NextView > v.realView`, this accepts view changes for views in the range `(realView, currView]`. The code then broadcasts a *new* ViewChange with `NextView: vc.NextView` (an old view number). This "help lagging nodes" re-broadcast sends a ViewChange for an already-completed view, which will be received and registered by `v.viewChangeMsgs` on *other* nodes only if `vc.NextView == v.currView+1` (per the first check) — which is not the case here. So the re-broadcast is largely harmless but confusing: it sends a ViewChange for `vc.NextView <= v.currView`, which all other nodes that have already advanced will simply warn-log and ignore. However, a node that receives this re-broadcast might register it in `nvs`, updating its `n` map with a stale view number, and the `sendRecv` check might then falsely believe there is bi-directional communication with that node for a stale view.

**FINDING X-2: No validation that SignedViewData entries in NewView cover distinct nodes up to quorum**

File: `viewchanger.go:931-1094`

In `validateNewViewMsg`, `nodesMap` tracks duplicate signers but `validViewDataMsgs` is only incremented when a message passes full validation. There is no check that the final set of `validViewDataMsgs >= quorum` comes from `quorum` *distinct* nodes that are actually in the known node list (`v.NodesList`). A Byzantine leader could include `quorum` entries all from the same non-existing signer (the `nodesMap` deduplicates, so at most one entry per signer passes), but more subtly: there is no check that `svd.Signer` is a member of `v.NodesList`. An entry from an unknown node ID would pass signature verification (if the verifier accepts it) and increment `validViewDataMsgs`. This allows a Byzantine leader to craft a NewView with signatures from fake node IDs if the application's `Verifier.VerifySignature` does not independently enforce node membership.

**FINDING X-3: Recovery from WAL handles ViewChange record by doing nothing — node restarts without quorum context**

File: `state.go:147-150`

```go
if viewChangeMsg := lastPersistedMessage.GetViewChange(); viewChangeMsg != nil {
    ps.Logger.Infof("last entry in WAL is a viewChange message")
    return nil
}
```

When the last WAL record is a ViewChange, `Restore` returns successfully with `v.Phase = COMMITTED` and no other state. The ViewChanger's `Restore` channel (viewchanger.go:225-226) then fires `processViewChangeMsg(true)`, which calls `startViewChange` and sends ViewData to the (computed) new leader. But the ViewData message contains the current checkpoint (which may be stale) and the in-flight proposal (which may have been superseded). The node restarts believing it is at sequence `mySequence` (from the checkpoint) with an in-flight at `mySequence+1`. If the actual cluster has advanced to a different sequence, the new leader's `checkLastDecision` will reject this node's ViewData as "too far behind" (if it's more than 1 behind) or silently exclude it. The node may then time out and start another view change — which is the correct behavior for liveness — but the interaction with `committedDuringViewChange` (never reset) could cause a false suppression of the in-flight on the second view-change attempt.

**FINDING X-4: processViewDataMsg re-prepares ViewData msg for leader even though the leader's state may have changed since original vote collection**

File: `viewchanger.go:763`

```go
myMsg := v.prepareViewDataMsg() // since it might have changed by now
```

The comment acknowledges the state might have changed. But `prepareViewDataMsg` calls `v.Checkpoint.Get()` and `v.InFlight.InFlightProposal()` at the time of NewView construction, which may reflect a state *after* delivering a last decision during the ViewData collection phase (`checkLastDecision` at line 617-665 may have called `deliverDecision`). The resulting ViewData message used in the NewView may contain a `LastDecision` at sequence `S+1` while some of the collected ViewData messages contain `LastDecision` at sequence `S`. `CheckInFlight` uses `maxLastDecisionSequence` to determine `expectedSequence`, so this inconsistency causes it to use `S+1+1 = S+2` as the expected in-flight sequence — but the actual in-flight is at `S+1`. The in-flight will be treated as "not at expected sequence" and counted as `noInFlightCount`, potentially triggering a false "condition B" (no in-flight) when there actually is a prepared in-flight at `S+1`.
